description: Preflights the official DC Corporate Registration table with metadata and aggregate counts only, then builds acknowledged privacy-selected active-entity fixtures into checksum-verified, non-overwriting local-review-only releases.

offline_source.description: Operator-supplied exact 24-field JSONL/NDJSON fixture containing only the two source-defined active statuses.

redirect_policy: Reject every redirect. Accept only HTTPS on the exact maps2.dcgis.dc.gov host, no port, credentials, fragment, or unapproved path. Live requests are limited to one metadata request and six exact aggregate/count-only forms.
retry: No automatic retries. Redirects, HTTP errors, ArcGIS errors, response overages, schema drift, vocabulary drift, non-reconciling counts, non-unique active FILE_NUMBER controls, fixture count mismatch, privacy leakage, duplicate identity, or verification failure stop the run.
checkpoint: The live preflight records exact selected schema, all-status and all-MODELTYPE aggregate counts, total and distinct FILE_NUMBER counts, active distinct FILE_NUMBER count, and maximum DCS_LAST_MOD_DTTM without requesting record rows. The offline build hashes its operator fixture, writes only to a new UUID-scoped .staging directory, verifies it, then atomically promotes it to a checksum-verified non-overwriting release without a current pointer.
idempotency: Source maximum DCS_LAST_MOD_DTTM plus the operator fixture SHA-256 identify the offline source release. FILE_NUMBER, compared case-insensitively and preserved exactly in provenance, is the candidate organization key. Duplicate active identities fail closed.
cancellation: Abort live requests and fixture streaming cooperatively. Remove unpublished UUID-scoped staging, surface cleanup failures, and never create or modify a production pointer.
retention_profile: Retain checksum-verified, non-overwriting internal selected-field snapshots and local-review-only normalized artifacts only under the approved project retention process; filesystem immutability and production retention are not asserted.
